datasets.contamination_policy: Thresholds, prompts and hyperparameters are tuned only against the datasets whose split_role is 'tuning'. A dataset with the role 'validation' may be scored but never tuned against. A dataset with the role 'held_out' may be read only by the final scoring step, and a tuning script that reads it has to fail. Two datasets of this repository carry the role 'held_out' today: the verification_heldout, which is the labelled set of the blind reading, and the orchestration_comparison, which is the pre-registration of the comparison of the orchestration studio, so that only the final scoring of that comparison reads it. The answer key of the generator that wrote the set is not published, because a key that is public is not a key, and the two readings were instructed to be blind to it: each of them disagrees with it in two of the forty eight cases. No number over any other dataset of this repository may be presented as a generalization to unseen data.
datasets.notes: The decisions of the agent were read against this set, so it is a tuning set: the answer key of EC-19 to EC-24 was changed after an online run, the trajectory equivalence that lets get_ledger_record count as query_ledger was added for the six status lookups EC-13 to EC-18 so the tool the agent chose would count, and the questions of EC-02, EC-04 and EC-10 are the few shot examples of the system prompt of the agent with their tool plans. Thirty cases show a tendency and not a significance. It has one labeling pass and the repository has no mechanism to version a second one yet. This set is a tuning set, so no number over it is a generalization to unseen data.
datasets.source: The cases are generated by ledgerlens/eval/dataset.py over the sample ledger of data/scenarios.json: 12 from the planted scenarios and 18 natural ones from the generated tables, with the expected values read from the tables by code. They are read by ledgerlens/eval/run.py and by tests/eval/test_dataset.py.

datasets.notes: The file holds one JSON object per line, so that the manifest of the datasets can count its records and pin its digest like the records of every other dataset. The set of the comparison is the 31 cases of the eval_cases, and the file names the digest of the set and the digest of the ledger so that a comparison whose arms read different ledgers is refused. Nothing of the studio was tuned against this set, because the studio does not exist yet in the shipped configuration.
datasets.source: The pre-registration of the comparison of the orchestration studio against the single agent, written by hand before the comparison ran, with the set of the comparison, the denominator, the two arms, the measures, the rule that decides the result and the uncertainty of the measurement. It is read by the final scoring of the comparison and by nothing else.

datasets.notes: The held out set of the retrieval, built so that the comparison of the retrieval has a set that no decision was taken against: the twelve questions of policy_questions are a tuning set, because ADR-006 chose the embedding and the query transform with the recall over them. The four counts of the reading: the two readings diverged in 4 of 16 cases, the first reading diverged from the recipes in 4 of 16, the second in 2 of 16, and the adjudication agrees with the recipes in 15 of 16. The adjudication corrected the recipe of RH-04, because the question asks how to explain the gap to the customer and the section of the explanation is the one that answers it, and the disagreement counts. The question RH-09 is ambiguous, because the rounding of the fees and the rounding of the cross currency policy both answer it, and the caveat is recorded here. No threshold, no embedding and no query transform was chosen against this set.
datasets.source: The questions are written by the generator of ledgerlens/eval/retrieval_heldout.py over the sections of the eight policies of data/policies/ that are not gold chunks of the tuning questions, and the relevance labels are the adjudication of two blind machine readings, under ADR-059.

datasets.notes: The labels come from two independent blind machine readings with an adjudication of the divergences, each one instructed to be blind to the recipe of the case (ADR-059), and each one disagreeing with the key of the generator in two of the forty eight cases. The divergence between the two readings measures the noise of the rule with no answer key near it, and the divergence of each reading against the recipes measures the distance between a blind reading and the expectation of the writer. The reading is a machine reading, so it may share a blind spot with the model that the set measures, and the number over the set cannot claim to be free of it. It has one labeling pass and the repository has no mechanism to version a second one yet. No number over any other dataset of this repository may be presented as a generalization to unseen data.
datasets.source: The cases are written by the generator ledgerlens/eval/heldout.py over the synthetic ledger of the seed 7301, in six templates of eight instances each, and their labels are written by the reading session of scripts/label_heldout.py. The file is read by scripts/measure_heldout.py and by ledgerlens/eval/heldout_reader.py.

datasets.source: The sentences come from two online runs of the scenarios of data/scenarios.json with gpt-4.1-mini: 28 written by the model and 12 changed by hand, each with the evidence the tools returned. They are read by tests/verify/test_verification_live.py.
